name: Virag Movie Lab
description: Dedicated movie-poster, cinematic-theme, OTT-cover, brand/product movie-style and current-trend inspiration presets.
masterRule: MOVIE LAB MASTER: Use only the current request and current uploads as the active brief. Detect whether the hero is a product, person, food, place, object, logo/brand asset or text-only concept. Build an ORIGINAL cinema-marketing creative around that subject. Preserve supplied product/face/brand facts exactly. Do not recreate or closely copy an official movie poster, official key art, title treatment, studio logo, character costume, exact composition or distinctive copyrighted artwork. When a real movie is named as inspiration, extract only high-level genre, mood, pacing, scale, lighting, typography category and marketing principles, then create a materially original composition. One output equals one standalone concept unless the user explicitly requests otherwise.
trendPolicy: Trend-reference cards are inspiration guides, not replication prompts. Refresh famous/current references using fresh research when available; preserve the generic cinematic mechanism even if the reference title changes.

commands.label: Movie Poster
commands.desc: Original theatrical key-art poster for the current subject or brief
commands.prompt: Create an original premium theatrical movie-style poster from the current brief/upload. Use strong cinematic key art, deliberate focal hierarchy, dramatic lighting, controlled typography and theatrical polish. Preserve the supplied subject accurately and do not imitate any specific official poster composition.

commands.label: Teaser Poster
commands.desc: Minimal mystery-first one-sheet with cinematic tension
commands.prompt: Create an original teaser one-sheet with one unforgettable focal idea, restrained copy, controlled negative space and cinematic mystery. Build anticipation without copying an existing film poster.

commands.label: Character Poster
commands.desc: Single-hero cinematic character or subject key art
commands.prompt: Create an original single-hero character-style cinematic poster focused on the current supplied person/product/subject. Preserve identity or product accuracy and build dramatic key art around it.

commands.label: Ensemble Poster
commands.desc: Layered multi-subject theatrical composition
commands.prompt: Create an original ensemble movie-poster composition using only the distinct current subjects the user supplied or requested. Build clear cast/subject hierarchy, depth and cinematic balance without copying a known ensemble poster layout.

commands.label: OTT Cover
commands.desc: Streaming-platform movie or series cover with strong thumbnail readability
commands.prompt: Create an original premium OTT/streaming cover with strong focal readability at small size, cinematic polish, clean title zone and platform-ready composition. Preserve supplied subject truth.

commands.label: Motion Poster Key Art
commands.desc: Still key art designed to animate cleanly into a motion poster
commands.prompt: Create original movie-poster key art specifically designed for later motion animation: separated visual layers, clear depth planes, atmospheric elements and one strong reveal-ready focal point.

commands.label: Trailer Frame
commands.desc: Cinematic trailer-like hero frame for social or campaign use
commands.prompt: Create one original cinematic trailer-frame style key visual from the current subject/brief with film-like framing, motivated lighting, believable depth and premium color language.

commands.label: Product Movie Poster
commands.desc: Exact product transformed into a cinematic movie-theme campaign hero
commands.prompt: Use the current uploaded product as the exact immutable hero and create an original cinematic movie-poster advertising world around it. Preserve packaging geometry, label, logo, colors and visible details exactly. The result must still read as a designed commercial poster, not a plain product photo.

commands.label: Brand Movie Campaign
commands.desc: Brand campaign with theatrical movie-marketing drama
commands.prompt: Create an original theatrical brand campaign using only supplied/visible brand cues. Use cinematic storytelling, poster hierarchy and dramatic visual world-building without borrowing another film's identity.
